Divides by gamma instead of multiplying, reversing the effect
Uses gamma minus one rather than gamma itself

Quoting t0 ignores dilation, dividing by gamma reverses the effect, and using gamma minus one confuses dilation with the kinetic-energy factor.
questions.hint: Use t = gamma times the proper time, with gamma = 1/sqrt(1 minus beta squared).
